_classes.name: Local boards of elections stored as the State Board of Elections
_classes.rule: agency == 'Board of Elections' (agency_full 'State Board of Elections', jurisdiction state) and 'state' not in actor_raw.lower() and 'state' not in actor_resolved_model.lower()  (model itself said 'boards of elections' / 'county boards of elections'; should be agency 'Boards of elections', jurisdiction local)

_classes.name: Pre-2017 record built on reprinted text whose only braced token is a single capitalized word or acronym (ufsd, shall, tlc, mayor)
_classes.rule: session < 2017; locate quote in packet LAW TEXT with [deleted] removed; braced chars inside the quote span form exactly one alphabetic word of 2-6 letters that is not a number/ordinal/roman numeral word. Candidate filter only: some hits are genuine one-word amendments, so each needs a read

_classes.name: actor_raw annotated or invented instead of the law's own words (passive subject plus parenthetical actor)
_classes.rule: '(' in actor_raw and actor_raw.lower() not a substring of the packet LAW TEXT (braces/brackets stripped, lowercased)

2013-S3070-01.quote: If satisfied that the Pelham Jewish Center would otherwise be entitled to such exemption if such not-for-profit organization had acquired the subject property and filed an application for exemption by the appropriate taxable status date, the assessor, upon approval by the Town of Pelham, Village of Pelham Manor and Pelham ufsd Board, may make appropriate correction to the subject roll.

2013-S3070-02.note: Operative 'the assessor, upon approval by the Town of Pelham, Village of Pelham Manor and Pelham {{ufsd}} Board, may make appropriate correction to the subject roll' is reprinted text; the only brace is 'ufsd', an uppercase acronym braced by the pre-2017 rule, and at most renames a body in the approval condition. action_summary's '(ufsd board added)' rests on that artefact.
2013-S3070-02.quote: the assessor, upon approval by the Town of Pelham, Village of Pelham Manor and Pelham ufsd Board, may make appropriate correction to the subject roll.

2011-S5672-01.quote: The secretary shall designate by rule or regulation the terms in a foreign language that shall be deemed to mean or imply that a notary public is licensed to practice law in the state of new york

2011-S5672-02.quote: The secretary of state may suspend a notary public upon a second violation of any of the provisions of this section and may remove from office a notary public upon a third violation of any of the provisions of this section

2011-S5672-03.quote: The civil penalty provided for by this subdivision shall be recoverable in an action instituted by the attorney general on his or her own initiative or at the request of the secretary.

2011-S5672-04.quote: The secretary may promulgate rules and regulations governing the provisions of this section, including the size and type of statements that a notary public is required by this section to post.

effective_date.note: 'on the one hundred eightieth day after it shall have become a law', signed 2011-09-23 + 180 days

2015-S1848-01.note: 'The board of Elections may authorize election officials to affix a paster or sticker upon unvoted ballots' (Election Law 7-126) is the county/NYC board that runs the poll site; the model resolved 'boards of elections' but the store mapped it to State Board of Elections. (Definition of 'board of elections' as the county/city board is Election Law 1-104, outside the packet text.)
2015-S1848-01.quote: The board of Elections may authorize election officials to affix a paster or sticker upon unvoted ballots.

2015-S1848-02.note: 'All of the voted ballots for which the use of a paster or sticker shall have been authorized shall be manually canvassed' is canvassed by the local board; stored as State Board, and actor_raw 'voted ballots (board of elections)' is not the law's wording.
2015-S1848-02.quote: All of the voted ballots for which the use of a paster or sticker shall have been authorized shall be manually canvassed and shall not be canvassed by a ballot scanner.

2009-S7075-01.quote: children of emergency medical technicians killed in the line of duty shall be entitled to receive an additional ten points in a competitive examination for original appointment in the same municipality in which his or her parent has served

2009-S7075-02.quote: Such candidates shall be allowed a period of not less than two months from the date of the filing of his or her application for examination in which to establish by appropriate documentary proof his or her eligibility to receive additional credit under this section.

2009-S7075-03.quote: The department and each municipal commission shall establish and maintain in its office a roster of all such children appointed as a result of additional credits granted by this section to positions under its jurisdiction.
